architectural_synthesis: Sigmoid calibration with fold-local preprocessing markedly improves both log loss (0.6774 -> 0.3992) and multiclass Brier score (0.3863 -> 0.2229). However, because non-linear calibration warps probability space, TreeSHAP on the base estimator produces log-odds/uncalibrated probabilities. The serving contract must explicitly distinguish calibrated output from base-model SHAP explanations.
